---

## Why Reddit Drives AI Recommendations

Reddit is one of the most heavily weighted sources in AI training data and real-time retrieval. When a user asks ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, or Google AI for a product or service recommendation, those systems frequently surface Reddit discussions. Brands that appear authentically in those conversations — with positive, helpful mentions — are more likely to be recommended by name.

ReddiReach builds that presence systematically, across the subreddits where your buyers are active.

## Services

### 1. GEO (Generative Engine Optimization)

Get your brand cited and recommended by AI search engines.

- AI visibility audit: benchmark where your brand shows up today across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI, and where competitors are winning instead
- Answer-ready content: articles and pages written to be cited by AI — answer-first structure, well-sourced, genuinely useful
- Schema and structured data: Organization, FAQ, and product schema so AI systems can parse who you are, what you offer, and why you are credible
- AI citation tracking: ongoing monitoring of your brand mentions across AI engines with weekly reporting on which prompts you are winning

URL: https://www.reddireach.com/services/geo

### 2. Reddit Marketing

Build authentic brand presence on Reddit through expert-led engagement.

- 20 targeted comments per month in niche subreddits where your buyers are active
- Thread monitoring to spot relevant conversations as they happen
- Mention-share tracking versus key competitors
- Monthly reporting on reach, engagement, and AI citation frequency

URL: https://www.reddireach.com/services/reddit

### 3. Technical SEO

- Schema markup: Organization, WebSite, FAQ, Product, BlogPosting
- Metadata and title optimization across all pages
- Site structure and crawlability improvements
- AI crawler access (robots.txt, llms.txt, structured data)

URL: https://www.reddireach.com/services/seo

### 4. Link Building

High-authority, relevant link acquisition from publications and sites in your niche, increasing domain authority and the likelihood of AI systems sourcing your content.

URL: https://www.reddireach.com/services/link-building

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: How long until I see results?
A: Reddit engagement results are often visible within 4-8 weeks. AI search optimization is longer — AI systems need time to incorporate your brand into their training data and retrieval results. Most clients see meaningful AI citation improvements within 3-6 months.

Q: Is this spam or astroturfing?
A: No. Every comment and post is written by a real human on our team, contributing genuine value to communities. We follow all Reddit guidelines and community rules. Our approach is about being helpful, not promotional.

Q: What AI platforms do you optimize for?
A: ChatGPT (OpenAI), Perplexity, Gemini (Google), Google AI Overviews, and Google AI Mode. We track brand mentions across all of them using AI Peekaboo.

Q: Do you require long-term contracts?
A: We require a 3-month minimum commitment. AI search optimization and authentic Reddit marketing take time to show compounding results. Three months lets us run a real strategy and demonstrate meaningful ROI.

Q: Can you work with our existing marketing team?
A: Yes. We regularly collaborate with in-house teams and other agencies, integrating with existing workflows and marketing strategies.
